ui.parents_gate: This part is for grown-ups. Ask a grown-up!
ui.title: My Zoo Game
keeper.welcome_first: Hi! I'm the zookeeper. Lots of animals live here. Let's go and meet them!
keeper.welcome_back: Hello again! The animals are waiting!
keeper.map_choose: Who shall we visit? Tap an animal!
keeper.map_locked: We'll go here a little later.
keeper.album_open: This is your album! Your stickers live here.
keeper.album_empty: It's empty for now. Visit an animal to get a sticker!
keeper.album_full: Hooray! You know every animal in the zoo!
keeper.time_up: The animals are going to rest. Time for us too! See you soon!
keeper.safety: In a real zoo, only zookeepers feed the animals. But in our game, we can help!
zone.savanna: The African savanna. It's hot here, with lots of grass.
zone.asia: Asia. Bamboo and tall trees grow here.
zone.rainforest: The rainforest. It's warm here, and it often rains.
zone.forest: Our forest. Here are fir trees, mushrooms and berries.
zone.north: The North. Here is snow and ice.
zone.lake: The lake. Animals who love water live here.
hint.tap_animal: Tap the animal to say hello!
hint.drag_food: Hold the food with your finger and drag it to the animal.
hint.drag_food_short: Drag the food to the animal!
hint.idle_1: Give it a try! I'll help.
oops.05: Oops! Not that one. Let's keep looking!
feed.not_mine: No, thank you. I don't eat that.
care.wash_ask: Let's give the animal a bath! Rub with the sponge.
care.clean_ask: Let's tidy up! Clear away the leaves.
care.sleep_ask: The animal is tired. Let's put it to bed.
game.find_baby: Where is the baby hiding? Find it!
game.find_baby_done: There it is! Mommy and baby are together!
game.puzzle: Put the picture together! Move the pieces into place.
game.tracks: Whose footprints are these? Follow them!
reward.sticker: Here's a sticker! It's in your album now.
reward.toy: Look, the animal has a new toy!
animal.lion.hello: Hi! I'm a lion! I'm very brave!
animal.lion.fact: The lion is the king of the animals. You can hear his roar from far, far away!
animal.lion.feed_ask: What shall we feed the lion?
animal.giraffe.hello: Hi! I'm a giraffe! Look at my long neck!
animal.giraffe.fact: The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world. It can reach leaves at the very top of a tree.
animal.giraffe.feed_ask: What shall we feed the giraffe?
animal.zebra.hello: Hi! I'm a zebra! I'm all stripy!
animal.zebra.fact: Every zebra has its own stripes. No two zebras are the same!
animal.zebra.feed_ask: What shall we feed the zebra?
animal.elephant.fact: The elephant is the biggest animal on land. It uses its trunk to pick up food and water.
animal.elephant.feed_ask: What shall we feed the elephant?
animal.elephant.food_hint: Elephants eat grass, twigs and bananas.
animal.hippo.hello: Hi! I'm a hippo! I love to splash!
animal.hippo.fact: Hippos spend almost all day in the water to stay cool.
animal.hippo.feed_ask: What shall we feed the hippo?
animal.hippo.food_hint: Hippos eat grass. They love watermelon too!
animal.panda.fact: Pandas eat bamboo almost all day long: stems, leaves and young shoots.
animal.panda.feed_ask: What shall we feed the panda?
animal.panda.yum: Crunch, crunch! Bamboo is so yummy!
animal.tiger.hello: Hi! I'm a tiger! Look at my stripes!
animal.tiger.fact: The tiger is the biggest cat. And tigers love to swim!
animal.tiger.feed_ask: What shall we feed the tiger?
animal.orangutan.hello: Hi! I'm an orangutan! I live in a tree!
animal.orangutan.fact: Every evening, an orangutan builds a cozy nest of branches up in a tree.
animal.orangutan.feed_ask: What shall we feed the orangutan?
animal.kangaroo.hello: Hi! I'm a kangaroo! Hop, hop!
animal.kangaroo.fact: A mommy kangaroo carries her baby in a pouch on her tummy.
animal.kangaroo.feed_ask: What shall we feed the kangaroo?
animal.bear.fact: Brown bears sleep in a den all winter long.
animal.bear.feed_ask: What shall we feed the brown bear?
animal.bear.food_hint: Bears eat berries, fish and honey.
animal.wolf.fact: Wolves live together in a big family. It's called a pack.
animal.wolf.feed_ask: What shall we feed the wolf?
animal.fox.hello: Hi! I'm a fox! Look at my fluffy tail!
animal.fox.fact: When a fox sleeps, it wraps its fluffy tail around itself like a blanket.
animal.fox.feed_ask: What shall we feed the fox?
animal.fox.food_hint: Foxes eat meat, berries and eggs.
animal.moose.hello: Hi! I'm a moose! Look at my antlers!
animal.moose.fact: The moose is the biggest deer of all. And it's a great swimmer!
animal.moose.feed_ask: What shall we feed the moose?
animal.deer.fact: Deer can run fast and jump high.
animal.deer.feed_ask: What shall we feed the deer?
animal.deer.food_hint: Deer eat grass, leaves and acorns.
animal.squirrel.fact: Squirrels hide nuts and mushrooms, so they have food in winter.
animal.squirrel.feed_ask: What shall we feed the squirrel?
animal.squirrel.food_hint: Squirrels eat nuts, pine cones and mushrooms.
animal.squirrel.yum: Yum! I'll save some for winter!
animal.polar_bear.hello: Hi! I'm a polar bear! I'm not cold at all!
animal.polar_bear.fact: Polar bears live where there is snow and ice. They swim very well in cold water.
animal.polar_bear.feed_ask: What shall we feed the polar bear?
animal.penguin.hello: Hi! I'm a penguin! Waddle, waddle!
animal.penguin.fact: A penguin is a bird. It can't fly, but it's a super fast swimmer!
animal.penguin.feed_ask: What shall we feed the penguin?
animal.crocodile.hello: Hi! I'm a crocodile! Don't worry, I'm friendly!
animal.crocodile.fact: A crocodile lies very still in the water. You can only see its eyes and nose.
animal.crocodile.feed_ask: What shall we feed the crocodile?
animal.flamingo.hello: Hi! I'm a flamingo! I can stand on one leg!
animal.flamingo.fact: Flamingos are pink because they eat tiny pink shrimp.
animal.flamingo.feed_ask: What shall we feed the flamingo?
